track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 12: Zang-e Shotor
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Zang-e Shotor in Chahargah, Rast-Panjgah, Segah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on A in Zang-e Shotor. The line peaks at E4 (331.6 Hz) at 1:18.4. It closes on the tonic (D3 → D3 → D4 → D4 → D3 → D3).
